content_zh:
冲进神龙侯府就是一声大吼。
龙飞的爆脾气上来了。
大门口的几名侍卫微微一震，有一人小声说道：“这不是龙飞那个大废物吗？他不是离开火璃城了，怎么又回来了……”
话音还没说完。
“啪！”
巴掌落在他的脸上，瞬间趴在地上变成死狗。
龙飞目光阴冷，冷哼一声，“狗东西，本少主的名字是你这种下人可以叫的吗？”
声音之中透着霸气威严，将龙家几名侍卫全都给震住。
要知道刚才那名侍卫的修为达到二级战师境界，却被龙飞一巴掌给扇晕过去。
半年不见，龙飞已经不在是以前的龙飞了。
“咦，那不是废物龙飞吗？他怎么还活着啊？”
“啪！”
“啊……你敢打我，龙飞你这种废物也敢对我动手，我……”
“啪！”
又是一巴掌掀翻，直接晕死过去。
神龙侯府很大。
一路上，不断有人被掀翻，不管是龙家弟子，还是龙家的奴役下人，只要敢说龙飞废物的全都放到在地。
“龙飞，你想做什么？”
“硬闯神龙侯府不成？”
“龙飞，你给我停下，否则休怪我不客气……”

就在这时候。
两列龙家军，身穿铠甲，步伐整齐，手里清一色拿着龙家军标准的龙神钢枪，齐刷刷的指着龙飞。
为首的是一名小头领，龙山。
他并不是龙家的人，‘龙’这个姓是龙家太祖赐给他的，他祖上也是追随太祖厮杀的龙家军之一，因为功勋卓著，被太祖赐姓。
龙山在年轻一辈中也算是佼佼者，达到四级战师境界。
龙飞眉头一拧，“龙飞？”
“本少主的名字岂是你能叫的？”
“龙山，你身为龙家禁军却不分主次，直呼少主名字，你好大的胆子。”龙飞沉声喝道，直接碾压着龙山。
在龙家谁都知道龙飞是少主。
是太爷在宗祠中亲自指认的接班人。
不管是变成废物，还是现在，龙飞都是龙家未来的主人。
身为龙家禁军就必须尊敬。
直呼其名这是对少主的大不敬，对龙家的不敬。
这一年来，谁把龙飞当回事了？
谁还认为他是龙家的少主？
没有人！
龙山和他的禁军也是一样。龙山心里虽然知道叫龙飞的名字是不对的，可是龙家的未来不应该落在一个废物手上，顿时喝出一声，“少主？你根本不配，根本没资格！龙飞，你最好给我消停一点，否则的休怪我不客气。”
龙飞笑了，冷冷的笑了起来，“我不配是吧？”
“那好！”
“老子今天就让知道什么叫着资格。”

话音一落。
“砰砰砰……”
“呱呱呱……”
龙飞的忽然跃起，四肢摊开，随后重重的趴在地上，喉咙里发出‘呱呱’怪叫声，就如一只大蛤蟆。
在他的身体周围，尘土被他身上释放出来的劲气给震飞出去。
龙山脸色一狞，不屑道：“装神弄鬼……”
话还没有说完，龙山两眼一花，定睛一看，发现龙飞已经消失在原地。
“嗖……”
“哗啦啦……”
一道大蛤蟆似得飞影撞了上来，龙山两眼怒睁，不等他反应过来，身体凹陷，五脏六腑在翻滚，喉咙下血气翻滚，一口血水夺口而出，发出痛苦的惨叫，“啊……”
“砰！”
直接撞飞数十米，龙山的身体直接砸在一面墙上，墙面凹陷，成蜘蛛网似的裂开。
真气催动！
“绞杀！”
龙飞沉沉一喝。
“啊……”
龙山腹部一股力量将他五脏六腑搅动，紧抽在一起，无比难受，连连发出痛苦的惨叫声。
脸色苍白，冷汗如雨。
无比的狼狈，完全没有刚才得意嚣张的模样。
龙飞冷冷说道：“这资格够吗？”

龙山眼角的肌肉在颤动，吼出一声，“给我上！”
两列龙家禁军，一共十六人。
龙山的命令一下，十六柄龙神钢枪齐刷刷的指向龙飞。
龙飞眼神一眯，“你们不过是龙家的下人，敢用武器指着你们的主人，给你们一次机会，一次活命的机会。”
“给我滚开！”
声音如雷，在十六人心神中炸开。
他们的身体暗暗颤抖。
龙飞是少主，他们对付少主，就是大不敬，这是要杀头的。
他们看着龙山。
这个时候龙山已经被‘绞杀’剧烈的疼痛给弄晕过去，这还是因为蛤蟆功只用了三层力量，如果全力的话，他已经死了。
众人害怕，一人让开退路，紧接着其他人也让出路来。
此刻的龙飞给他们的感觉太陌生了。

content_en:
He burst into the Shenlonghou Mansion with a loud roar.
Long Fei's temper grew.
Several guards at the gate were slightly shocked, and one of them whispered: "Isn't this that big loser Long Fei? Didn't he leave Huoli City, why did he come back..."
The words are not finished yet.
"Crack!"
The slap fell on his face, and he instantly fell to the ground and turned into a dead dog.
Long Fei's eyes were cold and he snorted coldly, "Bitch, is this young master's name something that a servant like you can call me?"
The voice was filled with domineering majesty, which shocked all the guards of the Long family.
You must know that the guard's cultivation just now reached the level of a second-level combat master, but he was knocked unconscious by Long Fei's slap.
Not seeing each other for half a year, Long Fei is no longer the same Long Fei he used to be.
"Hey, isn't that useless Long Fei? Why is he still alive?"
"Crack!"
"Ah... you dare to hit me, even a loser like Long Fei dares to attack me, I..."
"Crack!"
Another slap knocked him over and he fainted.
Shenlonghou Mansion is very big.
Along the way, people kept being overthrown. Whether they were disciples of the Long family or slaves of the Long family, anyone who dared to call Long Fei useless was thrown to the ground.
"Long Fei, what do you want to do?"
"Is it possible to forcefully break into the Shenlonghou Mansion?"
"Long Fei, please stop, otherwise don't blame me for being rude..."
That's when.
Two rows of Long family troops, wearing armor, marching in neat steps, all holding the Long family army's standard Dragon God steel spears in their hands, pointed at Long Fei.
The leader is a small leader, Longshan.
He is not from the Long family. The surname "Long" was given to him by the Taizu of the Long family. His ancestor was also one of the Long family troops who followed Taizu to fight. Because of his outstanding achievements, he was given the surname by Taizu.
Longshan is also considered a leader among the younger generation, reaching the level of a fourth-level combat master.
Long Fei frowned, "Long Fei?"
"How can you call me by my young master's name?"
"Longshan, you are a member of the Long family's imperial army, but you call the young master by his name regardless of priority. How brave of you." Long Fei shouted in a deep voice, crushing Longshan directly.
Everyone in the Long family knows that Long Fei is the young master.
He was the successor personally identified by the Grand Master in the ancestral hall.
Whether he became a waste or he is now, Long Fei is the future master of the Long family.
As a member of the Long family's forbidden army, you must respect him.
Calling him by his first name is disrespectful to the young master and disrespectful to the Long family.
Who has taken Long Fei seriously this year?
Who still thinks he is the young master of the Long family?
No one!
The same goes for Longshan and his Imperial Army. Although Longshan knew in his heart that calling Long Fei's name was wrong, the future of the Long family should not fall into the hands of a loser. He immediately shouted, "Young Master? You are not worthy at all, you are not qualified at all! Long Fei, you'd better calm down for a while, otherwise don't blame me for being rude."
Long Fei smiled, and laughed coldly, "I don't deserve it, do I?"
"That's good!"
"I will let you know what qualifications are today."
The words fell.
"Bang bang bang..."
"Quack, quack, quack..."
Long Fei suddenly jumped up, spread out his limbs, and then lay heavily on the ground, making a strange sound of "croaking" in his throat, just like a big toad.
Around his body, the dust was blown away by the energy released from his body.
Longshan's face turned grim, and he said disdainfully: "Pretend to be a ghost..."
Before he finished speaking, Longshan's eyes were dazzled. When he took a closer look, he found that Long Fei had disappeared.
"Whoosh..."
"Crash..."
A flying shadow like a big toad hit him. Longshan's eyes opened angrily. Before he could react, his body sunk, his internal organs were tumbling, blood boiled under his throat, a mouthful of blood came out of his mouth, and he let out a painful scream, "Ah..."
"Bang!"
After being hit for tens of meters, Longshan's body directly hit a wall. The wall was dented and cracked like a spider web.
Infuriating!
"Strangulation!"
Long Fei drank deeply.
"ah……"
A force in Longshan's abdomen stirred up his internal organs, tightening them together. It was extremely uncomfortable, and he let out repeated screams of pain.
His face was pale and he was sweating like rain.
He was extremely embarrassed, not at all as proud and arrogant as before.
Long Fei said coldly: "Is this qualification enough? "
The muscles in the corners of Longshan's eyes were trembling, and he roared, "Fuck me!" "
Two lines of Long family's forbidden troops, a total of sixteen people.
With Longshan's order, the sixteen Dragon God Steel Spears all pointed at Long Fei.
Long Fei narrowed his eyes, "You are just servants of the Long family. If you dare to point weapons at your master, I will give you a chance, a chance to survive. "
“Get out of my way! "
The sound was like thunder, exploding in the hearts of the sixteen people.
Their bodies trembled secretly.
Long Fei is the young master. It is disrespectful for them to deal with the young master, and they will be beheaded.
They looked at Longshan.
At this time, Longshan had already fainted from the severe pain of 'Strangulation'. This was because the Toad Kung Fu only used three levels of strength. If he had used all his strength, he would have died.
Everyone was scared, so one person gave way to retreat, and then the others also gave way.
The feeling of Long Fei at this moment was too strange to them.
